hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases y with positive steady-state gain (heater power raises temperature).
Response has noticeable lag / first-order-like time constant on order tens of seconds, not an instant jump.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward a low ambient near 0.05-0.10 rather than holding its value.
There is no large dead zone at low u; small u>0 produces a measurable rise.
Steady-state y is approximately linear in u without strong saturation below the soft limit.
The steady-state input needed to hold y=0.5 is in the mid-range approx 0.3-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (<0.01) so trends and end-slope are interpretable for gain and settling.

submission.machine_card: Heater: up = hotter. Self-drains to room ~0.07 (0=15C,1=75C). No dead zone: 0.3-0.5 all respond promptly. Lag: 6-12s initial delay + first-order tau ~120-150s, ~300s to settle. Rate limit <=0.006/s. Noise: quantization ~0.0054, variation <0.01. Equilibria measured: u=0.5->0.54 settled, u=0.45->0.518 settled, u=0.4->0.515 flat 120s, u=0.3->0.438 settled, u=0.37->0.459 after 180s still slowly rising (true ss ~0.47-0.49), u=0->decaying through 0.23 still falling toward ~0.07. Gain nonlinear saturating: low gain ~1.2, mid 0.3-0.4 gain ~0.77, high 0.4-0.5 gain ~0.25. Hold for target 0.5 is 0.30-0.40, best ~0.38. Overshoot costly (passive cooling). Stay below 0.85 soft / 0.9 hard cutoff.
submission.design_rationale: Plant is positive-gain, self-draining first-order with tau~130s and 6-12s delay. Measured equilibria (u,y): (0,~0.07), (0.3,0.438 settled), (0.37,0.459 still rising), (0.4,0.515 flat 120s), (0.45,0.518 settled), (0.5,0.54 settled). Gain saturates: ~1.23 low, ~0.77 at 0.3-0.4, ~0.25 at 0.4-0.5. Hold for y=0.5 interpolates in 0.3-0.4 segment to ~0.38. So use feedforward 0.38 from piecewise map + PI to trim residual. Kp=1.0 gives loop gain ~0.77 locally, stable for first-order+small delay and gives u=0.80 from cold (below 0.85 soft limit). Ki=0.012 (Ti=83s) corrects 0.05 FF error in ~80s once close. Filter Tf=12s smooths 0.005 quantization without adding lag vs 130s. Conditional integration only when |e|<0.12 and not saturated plus clamp +/-0.25 leaves >0.08 authority to cover (0.30,0.40) hold uncertainty while preventing warmup windup and overshoot, critical because cooling is passive. Clamp u to [0,0.80] stays clear of 0.9 cutoff and 0.85 soft limit while still fast enough to rise 0.08->0.5 in ~200s. Force u=0 if y>0.84 for safety margin vs noise.
submission.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.08: saturates ~0.80 then P-brakes, reaches 0.475 in ~190-230s, enters 0.475-0.525 without overshoot >0.015, settled by 300s. Steady duty ~0.36-0.40 (FF 0.38 plus integral trim). After 300s MAE <0.012 and time-in-band >90-95% (limited only by 0.005 quantization). From hot: cuts to 0 and coasts down. No oscillation; energy near minimum for this speed (steady u^2 ~0.14).
